target.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(observed_at / 1000.0) AS time, note AS text FROM observations WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(observed_at / 1000.0) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(sr.adjusted_time_ms / 1000.0) AS time, sr.measurement AS value, concat(COALESCE(d.tag, d.name, d.address, 'device'), ' ', sr.sensor) AS metric FROM sensor_readings sr JOIN devices d ON d.id = sr.device_id LEFT JOIN plant_sensors ps ON ps.device_id = d.id AND ps.sensor = sr.sensor LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.id = ps.plant_id WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(sr.adjusted_time_ms / 1000.0) AND ('${plant_name}' = '%' OR p.plant_name LIKE '${plant_name}') AND '${view_mode}' IN ('individual', 'both') ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(floor(sr.adjusted_time_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms} / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(sr.measurement) AS value, concat(COALESCE(d.tag, d.name, d.address, 'device'), ' avg') AS metric FROM sensor_readings sr JOIN devices d ON d.id = sr.device_id LEFT JOIN plant_sensors ps ON ps.device_id = d.id AND ps.sensor = sr.sensor LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.id = ps.plant_id WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(sr.adjusted_time_ms / 1000.0) AND ('${plant_name}' = '%' OR p.plant_name LIKE '${plant_name}') AND '${view_mode}' IN ('average', 'both') GROUP BY time, d.id, d.tag, d.name, d.address ORDER BY 1
